bug_semantics: When EMAIL_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED is enabled, NextAuth callbacks.signIn in apps/web/server/auth.ts rejects unverified users only inside the credentials (email/password) branch. The OAuth/OIDC branch (credentials undefined) never consults serverConfig.auth.emailVerificationRequired or user.emailVerified and returns true, so a remote OAuth callback can issue a next-auth.session-token for an email the server-wide policy was supposed to gate. Preconditions are non-default EMAIL_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED=true plus a configured OAuth/OIDC provider that does not itself enforce email ownership (CWE-287).
flaw_origin: The incomplete gate was first written in 93049e864ae6d281b60c23dee868bca3f585dd4a (2025-07-10, 'feat: Add support for email verification'). That commit introduced EMAIL_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED and placed the emailVerified throw only under if (credentials), then explicitly documented the OAuth skip with a TODO ('We're blindly trusting oauth providers to validate emails / oauth users can sign in even if email verification is enabled') before an unconditional return true. Parent aae3ef17eccf0752edb5ce5638a58444ccb6ce3a already had OAuth sign-in but no email-verification policy, so there was no policy to bypass until this first-write.

reasoning: Vulnerability first: EMAIL_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED is a single global login policy, but NextAuth signIn enforces user.emailVerified only when credentials is set. OAuth callbacks skip that branch, hit the acknowledged TODO, and return true, issuing a session. CVE-2026-75774 is PUBLISHED (not withdrawn/rejected), so this is a real CWE-287 inconsistency, not FALSE_POSITIVE. potential_fix.approach: After resolving user in callbacks.signIn, apply if (serverConfig.auth.emailVerificationRequired && user && !user.emailVerified) throw before both the credentials and OAuth success returns; for OAuth also require the provider profile email_verified claim to be true instead of blindly trusting profile.email.
potential_fix.rationale: Moving the existing credentials gate out of if (credentials) closes the skipped OAuth branch that currently reaches return true; requiring the OIDC email_verified claim addresses the root cause named in the BIC TODO.
